text: The composition of relations R and S on set A is another relation on A, denoted S o R. The pair (a, c) e SoR if and only if thereisab € A such that (a,b) e Rand (b, c) € S. The ordering of the relations R and S in the expression "S o R" may seem unusual because it is natural to read an expression from left to right. However, the ordering defined here for composition of relations is consistent with the ordering defined for composition of functions in which R is applied first and then S.
